{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ergesh Relations Office''' was a building in [[Outworlder City]] on the [[Ersheg]] continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]]. The building was an Ergeshui living construct. The office, staffed by ten of the native [[Ergesh]] working to ensure a good relationship between the off-worlder [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] having business on Ergeshui, and the natives.
